title: AC1021 AcExpr physical FIELD graph output readiness screen
scope: Determine whether the 15 complete AC1021 AcExpr FIELD records in the existing local source form an output-eligible graph with exact ownership, FIELDLIST membership, and consumer-visible references.

source.provenance: Pre-existing untracked local input. It was read for this census and was not staged or committed.

observations.acExprSourceFrames: All 15 records are complete flags=4/type=2 AcExpr FIELDs; the focused selector reports each handle, parent handle, FIELDLIST membership, source record offset, value profile, and table-reference count. Each is nested under a typed _text FIELD parent.

decision: No physical FIELD output route is admitted from this witness. Although the 15 AcExpr bodies and parent-child links are complete, the enclosing FIELDLIST includes 56 raw-only FIELD handles and the available typed tables have no references to these AcExpr roots. The source therefore lacks a complete FIELDLIST/output graph for this candidate.

implementationBoundary.changed: The opt-in AC1021 FIELD census selector now checks and reports owner, parent-child, FIELDLIST membership, TABLE/TABLECONTENT relation, and physical frame publication details. The source inventory selector prints typed DICTIONARY/XRECORD owner and payload summaries for the standard-object frames.
implementationBoundary.notChanged: No parser or writer admission was broadened. Physical FIELD output, FIELDLIST membership output, expression semantics, and native evaluation remain unqualified.
implementationBoundary.excluded: The 42 raw-only AcObjProp records, nine unresolved AcSm records, the negative-count record, 71 checksum child suffix cases, and other unexplained FIELD tails remain outside the candidate.

selector.result: PASS; 15/15 parent links, 15/15 single FIELDLIST memberships, zero TABLE/TABLECONTENT field references; 142 slots versus 86 typed and 56 raw-only FIELDs.

standardObjectInventory.result: PASS; current AC1021 source inventory prints standard DICTIONARY/XRECORD owners, entry/value counts, reactors, and extension dictionary handles.

nextAction: Continue with P4: use the per-frame DICTIONARY/XRECORD summary to select one of the 30 unqualified standard-object frames whose owner and references form a closed physical graph; add strict output, ASCII/Binary readback, atomic refusal, and same-adapter retry for that graph.
